data_recovery.reason: Legacy export encoded negative-opening finger motor targets as positive close commands.
data_recovery.method: Recovered binary gripper commands from recorded HDF5 raw actions; measured gripper observations recovered from named joint angles.

limitations: One kitchen and seed; no arbitrary-task or multi-seed reliability claim.
Replay used a corrected export of an existing physical collection, not a newly collected episode.
Local modified source and externally downloaded assets; not an independent public reproduction.
SimVQA integrity and annotation consistency are checked, not a human-audited semantic benchmark.
